name: dsh-native-env-v2
description: DSH v2 native environment bridge with per-session takeover, TCP/SSH compatibility, fail-closed disconnects, and tool directory negotiation.

meta.title: Native Env v2
meta.description: Connect one DSH session to another DSH tool environment with explicit per-session enter/exit and fail-closed transport handling.

note.rows: The host half is mounted by ABSOLUTE PATH at the profile plane; the guest half is mounted in the REMOTE machine's own profile.
note.discovery: The browser half needs no bundle entry. `dsh-client-modules` resolves a row's manifest by walking up from the row's module file (see `nearestPackage` in that package), so an absolute-path row pointing at this package is found as long as this manifest declares `dsh.client` and `exports["./client"]` — which is why the deployment shape did not have to change.

comment: Zero npm dependencies. The v2 bundle keeps the legacy env/* wire adapter, adds env2/* negotiation and structured capabilities, and never silently falls back to local tools after a disconnect.
